design.cache: warm OS cache; no eviction; untimed per-case/key warmup each block
design.oracle: same shared read_matrix.rs; all38 full pages/order/versions and256 gets; checks outside timing
design.workload: all38 cases each round including8 pages; same seeded query/get shuffle per matching block
design.timing: count and full owned payload result; get interleaved; no CLI JSON roundtrip
design.source_validation: FDB strict open full source/index checks before queries; SQLite no full integrity on open
design.process: two resident FDB oracle workers; per-block exclusive DB open; fresh SQLite process per block; no overlapping queries
design.limits: no power/hardware isolation; two process pairs; no significance claim; query OS RAM and true cold/concurrent unmeasured
